gloss: quickly, at once, hurry up and

definitions.explanation: An informal adverb urging someone to do something quickly or to get out of the way. Often used in commands with an impatient or irritated tone.

examples.japanese: とっとと⟦{帰|かえ}れ→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧。
とっとと⟦{宿題|しゅくだい}→宿題：00812_shukudai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{終|お}わらせ⟦なさい→なさる：01307_nasaru⟧。
examples.english: Hurry up and finish your homework.

examples.japanese: ⟦こんな→こんな：02881_konna⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧、とっとと⟦{片付|かたづ}けて→片付ける：01192_katazukeru⟧⟦{遊|あそ}び→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}こう→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: Let's hurry up and get this work done so we can go have fun.

notes:
とっとと is colloquial and carries an impatient, somewhat rude tone. Use with caution in polite settings.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- とっとと + imperative: hurry up and ~
- とっとと + verb: quickly ~, without wasting time ~
- とっとと⟦{帰|かえ}れ→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧: go home already
- とっとと⟦やれ→やる：02980_yaru⟧: just do it already

USAGE: Often used when speaking to someone of equal or lower status, or when expressing frustration. Can also be used about oneself in a self-motivating way (とっとと{終|お}わらせよう — let me just get this done quickly).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦さっさと→さっさと：05795_sassato⟧: quickly, without dawdling (similarly impatient, slightly milder)
- ⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧: quickly, soon (neutral, polite)
